name: Stemnitsa – Dimitsana
description: The most dramatic section follows the Lousios River gorge, passing cliff-hanging monasteries and ancient bridges. The trail descends into the gorge and climbs back up through wild landscape.

name: Dimitsana – Zigovisti
description: A short, pleasant walk connecting Dimitsana to the quiet mountain village of Zigovisti. Follows old mule paths through forests with excellent views of the surrounding mountains.

name: Zigovisti – Elati
highlights: Pleiovouni peak (1,643m) – highest point on trail
description: The longest and most demanding section crosses the highest point of the entire trail at Pleiovouni peak. A true mountain crossing through fir forests and alpine meadows with stunning 360° panoramas.

name: Elati – Vytina
highlights: Vytina – main trail hub with full services
description: A relaxing walk through beautiful fir forests leading to Vytina, the largest town on the trail and the main services hub. Suitable for families with older children.

name: Vytina – Nymfasia
description: A short, easy section through shaded forest paths connecting Vytina to the picturesque village of Nymfasia. Ideal for a half-day walk with time to explore both villages.

name: Nymfasia – Magouliana
highlights: Dense fir and black pine forest
description: A challenging section with significant elevation change as the trail crosses the Mylaon River valley and climbs to Magouliana. Dense forest and mountain scenery throughout.

name: Magouliana – Valtesiniko
description: A moderate walk along old mule paths connecting two traditional Arcadian villages. The trail passes through a quiet pastoral landscape with mountain views and scattered springs.

name: Valtesiniko – Lagkadia
highlights: Ancient oak and plane tree groves
Final trail section – sense of completion
description: The final section of the Menalon Trail descends through the NE Gortynian mountains to the amphitheatrically built village of Lagkadia. A long but moderate walk to finish the journey.
